name: workbench
description: Workbench for Claude Code: a live narration band above the prompt and a side pane with this turn's steps, working tree changes and turn history.

language.title: Language / 语言
language.description: auto: follow Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; en: English; zh: 简体中文

bandMode.title: Narration placement
bandMode.description: band: above the prompt; status: one line in the status bar, so other band plugins can coexist; off: only the /workbench pane

narrationOverflow.title: Long narration
narrationOverflow.description: truncate: one line, full text on hover; wrap: more lines; scroll: slides sideways on Desktop (wraps in the terminal)

narratorMode.title: Narrator mode
narratorMode.description: full: reads tool calls plus the model's thinking and reply; lite: updates on tool calls only; off: no model calls, the band shows the current step

narratorIntervalSeconds.title: Narrator interval (seconds)
narratorIntervalSeconds.description: Minimum seconds between two narration updates, 3 to 120

narratorMaterialChars.title: New text before an update
narratorMaterialChars.description: In full mode, how many new characters the model writes before the narration updates again, 100 to 5000
